name: Hitozuma Sentai Aisaiger
original_name: 人妻戦隊アイサイガー
source:
Main character is equipment salesman now even though he used to be masked superhero enthusiast as a student. One day he picks up a strange card case full of blank cards. These cards turn out to be "Holga Card", a cosmic treasure that grants humans delusions in the form of reality. Magic Star Cluster Darakuza starts invasion to the Earth to find the cards.
Protagonist meets a masked superhero girl who asks him: "Do you believe in heroes?"

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公如今是一名器材销售员，学生时代却曾是蒙面英雄的狂热爱好者。一天，他捡到一个奇怪的卡盒，里面装满空白卡片。原来，这些是名为"Holga Card"的宇宙秘宝，能够把人类的妄想化为现实。为寻找卡片，魔法星团堕落座开始入侵地球。
主人公遇见一名蒙面女英雄，对方问他："你相信英雄吗？"

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
